_comment: Numbers for the KDP paperback cover. trim/paper/page_count are inputs; spine_in must be the value KDP's own cover calculator reports for exactly this page count and paper (do not estimate). build_cover.py cross-checks spine_in against KDP's published per-page thickness for the paper and refuses to build on a mismatch. If the interior page count changes, re-run the calculator and update both page_count and spine_in.
isbn_source: KDP-assigned (free). Locked to this paperback listing: cannot be reused with IngramSpark or any other printer/distributor, and the publisher displays as 'Independently published' -- that field is not editable. The Kindle edition needs no ISBN; leave it blank rather than reusing this one. Expanded Distribution is still available with a KDP-assigned ISBN.

listing.editions: paperback only -- no Kindle edition at this time
listing.price_strategy: USD 19.99 set as primary; other marketplaces auto-filled by KDP
listing.title: Geography as Destiny
listing.subtitle: A Probabilistic History of Human Civilization
_notes: Interior upload: answer NO BLEED. The PDF is exactly 6x9 with no bleed; the 0.125in bleed applies to the cover wrap only.
Paper must be CREAM. The 1.055in spine is calculated for cream (0.0025in/page); white (0.002252in/page) would give 0.950in and the printed cover would no longer fit.
KDP Select is ebook-only and does not apply to a paperback-only listing.
If a Kindle edition is added later: title, subtitle and author must match this listing exactly or the two will not link on one product page, and it must not reuse this ISBN.
Minimum list price is printing cost / 0.60. At 422pp the print cost is about $6.06, so the floor is about $10.11; $19.99 nets roughly $5.93 per copy.

source: KDP cover calculator, recorded with the print-interior build (commit bba673b, 'Print build: convert footnotes to per-chapter endnotes': 422pp / 1.055in cream spine)
